behavior.arguments: rdi = 192-bit out pointer (3 words), rsi = 128-bit in pointer (2 words), rdx = 64-bit scalar
behavior.borrow_mask: sbb %r8,%r8 after the 192-bit sub/sbb chain: 0 when out >= scalar*in, all-ones when out < scalar*in

edges.borrow_adds_modulus_back: out0 = (out0 - p0) + in0, out1 = (out1 - p1 - b0) + in1 + carry, out2 = scalar - 1
edges.discarded_top_word: out2 - p2 - borrow is computed in rax and never stored; out2 is unconditionally overwritten with scalar or scalar - 1
edges.no_borrow: out0 = out0 - p0, out1 = out1 - p1 - b0, out2 = scalar
edges.return_equals_stored_top_word: rax = rcx = the value stored to out + 0x10

behavior.meaning_of_inputs_and_modulus: unknown, not claimed; 'modulus' names only the observed add-back operand (the 128-bit input), not a proven modulus
behavior.product_words: p0 = lo(scalar * in0), p1 = hi(scalar * in0) + lo(scalar * in1) with carry, p2 = hi(scalar * in1) + carry
behavior.return_shape: rax = scalar when no borrow, scalar - 1 when borrow; fully determined (mov %rcx,%rax after the stores)
behavior.stored_rule: out0, out1 follow subtract-then-conditionally-add-back; out2 is scalar or scalar - 1, never the subtraction result

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

naming_relocation.note: no relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend; absence of a naming relocation does not identify provenance
